header: How we run the platform, stated plainly
subheadline: No badges, no seals, no marketing adjectives. If any of the following stops being true we will say so in the release notes before you read it somewhere else, and the status page keeps the full history.

items.title: Hosting
items.description_text: Frankfurt and Vienna, replicated between both. Nothing is processed outside the EU.

items.title: Uptime
items.description_text: 99.95% measured monthly across the dispatch board and the mobile sync endpoint.

items.title: Release cadence
items.description_text: One feature release a month, security patches within 72 hours of disclosure.

items.title: Data export
items.description_text: Full CSV and JSON export of jobs, assets and customers, available on every plan.

items.title: Notice period
items.description_text: Monthly plans end with 30 days' notice, and nothing is deleted for 90 days after.
